metadata.title: Privacy Policy | Pointet Workshop
metadata.description: How Pointet Workshop processes personal data, uses authentication cookies and handles your GDPR rights.

paragraph: We are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how Pointet Workshop collects, processes, stores and protects personal data when you use its website, account, ordering and contact services in France and the European Union.

Processing depends on the service you use and the relevant legal basis described below. Visiting the website does not constitute consent to every form of personal-data processing. The operator responsible for your data is identified in the Contact section.

list: Your email address and full name, which are required to register an account.
A hashed password, account identifier, role, email-verification status and account creation/update dates.
Current orders and purchase/order history, including customer name and email, products, selected colours, quantities, prices, order dates and statuses.
Basket contents associated with your account.

paragraph: Account records can include a referral relationship. When contacting us, you provide the selected service and your project description, together with any other information you choose to include in your message.

You may voluntarily provide a phone number or delivery address in correspondence to arrange an order or delivery. These are not required account-registration fields; the current account and order records do not have dedicated phone or delivery-address fields. A delivery address may be needed to fulfil a delivery you request.

Authentication cookies contain access and refresh tokens used to authenticate requests and renew sessions. They are security credentials, separate from profile information. Server-side session records include a hash of the refresh token, session and account identifiers, expiry and revocation information, usage timestamps, IP address and browser/device user-agent information. We also process your language preference through a separate cookie.

list: Create and manage accounts, verify email addresses and authenticate users.
Maintain authenticated sessions and securely renew authentication.
Manage baskets, process orders and maintain purchase/order history.
Fulfil purchased products and arrange delivery using the necessary details supplied for that purpose.
Contact you when necessary about an order and respond to enquiries or support requests.
Remember your chosen language.
Protect accounts and website security, including detecting misuse of refresh tokens.
Comply with applicable legal obligations.

paragraph: The applicable legal basis depends on the purpose of the processing:

list.text: Performance of a contract or steps requested before a contract:

list: account services, authentication needed to access them, order processing, fulfilment, requested delivery and related customer support.
keeping records required by applicable accounting or other laws, and responding to binding legal requests.
protecting the website and accounts against misuse, handling general enquiries and establishing or defending legal claims, where those interests are not overridden by your rights and freedoms.

only for a specific activity that is presented to you as relying on your consent. No separate consent-based analytics or advertising activity is currently implemented. Optional information is not automatically processed on the basis of consent; its purpose determines the legal basis.

paragraph: We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to provide the requested services, manage the contractual relationship, meet applicable legal or accounting obligations, and resolve disputes or enforce agreements where necessary. The appropriate period depends on the record, its purpose and any legal requirements.

Pending registrations expire after 24 hours by default, or are consumed when email verification is completed. The application does not specify a fixed deletion period for account, order or authentication-history records. Token expiry ends a credential's validity; it does not automatically delete the related records.

We use technical safeguards including password hashing, hashed refresh-token storage, signed access tokens, refresh-token rotation, request-origin checks and access controls. Appropriate organisational measures are also needed to protect information and limit its use to authorised purposes.
We do not sell personal information.

Information may be shared with service providers only as needed to operate and host the website, provide infrastructure and technical services, handle orders, or arrange a requested delivery. Information may also be disclosed where required by law or necessary to establish or defend legal claims. Any processor acting on our behalf must be subject to the applicable data-protection requirements.

list: the contact form opens an external WhatsApp link containing the selected service and project description. If you use this option, WhatsApp receives the information included in the link and processes information under its own privacy terms. Opening the link does not itself send the message to us; you decide whether to send it in WhatsApp.

the catalogue supports Amazon S3 storage for public product images. If your browser requests images directly from the storage service, the service receives connection information such as your IP address. This does not establish that account or order records are stored there.

paragraph: No integrated payment provider is currently implemented. If payment processing is introduced, any provider receiving personal information and the relevant processing will be described here. No external email-delivery provider has been confirmed.
[Hosting, infrastructure and any delivery providers processing customer data: operator to confirm their identities and roles.]
Depending on the circumstances and applicable legal conditions, you may:

list: Request access to your personal data and information about its processing.
Have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected.
Request deletion where there is no overriding reason to retain the data.
Request restriction of processing in the circumstances provided by law.
Object, on grounds relating to your situation, to processing based on legitimate interests.
Request portability of data you supplied where processing is automated and based on consent or a contract.
Withdraw consent where an activity relies on it, without affecting the lawfulness of processing before withdrawal.
Lodge a complaint with a competent supervisory authority.

paragraph: In France, the supervisory authority is the

paragraph.text: CNIL (Commission Nationale de l'Informatique et des Libertés)

paragraph: . Use the contact details below to exercise your rights. We may request information reasonably necessary to verify your identity. Some records may need to be retained to meet legal obligations or address legal claims, even after a deletion request.

Access-token and refresh-token cookies authenticate requests, maintain signed-in sessions and securely renew authentication. Their default security attributes are HttpOnly, Secure and SameSite=Lax, subject to the deployment qualification in the Data Security section.
A separate language-preference cookie remembers your selected locale and does not contain authentication tokens. For cookie purposes, durations and browser controls, see our

External communication and storage services may involve processing outside the European Economic Area (EEA). The project includes a WhatsApp contact link and S3 media storage, but the production hosting locations, recipient arrangements and applicable transfer safeguards have not been confirmed.

Where a transfer outside the EEA takes place, it must meet the GDPR's transfer requirements, for example through an applicable adequacy decision or appropriate safeguards. We do not claim that a particular mechanism is already in place.
[Operator to supply: relevant recipients and destination countries, applicable transfer mechanism, and how to obtain information about or a copy of any safeguards.]

We may update this policy when website functionality, data-processing practices or legal requirements change. The Last updated date identifies the latest revision. Any additional notice required for a material change will be provided as applicable.
